headline: Old Mountain Field and Saugatucket Park Lighting project updates, policy manual second reading, and recreation center hours change.
summary: The commission will review the Old Mountain Field capital improvement project and the Saugatucket Park lighting project status, hold a second reading of the 2026-2027 Policy Manual, and consider the Leisure Services capital improvement plan for FY27-28 to FY32-33 and a change to recreation center opening hours.
items: Old Mountain Field Capital Improvement Project Status
Saugatucket Park Lighting Project - Status Report
Second Reading of 2026-2027 South Kingstown Recreation Commission Policy Manual and Proposed Amendments
Leisure Services Proposed Departmental Capital Improvement Plan FY27-28 to FY32-33
Operating Hours of Recreation Center — Recommended Change of Opening Time from 7am to 7:30am
Next Meeting: Monday, November 16, 2026 at South Kingstown Recreation Center at 6:30pm
location: The Neighborhood Guild, 325 Columbia St., Peace Dale, RI
